    • calculateCPPos

      private double calculateCPPos(info.openrocket.core.aerodynamics.FlightConditions cond)
      Return the relative position of the CP along the mean aerodynamic chord. Below mach 0.5 it is at the quarter chord, above mach 2 calculated using an empirical formula, between these two using an interpolation polynomial.
      Parameters:
      cond - Mach speed used
      Returns:
      CP position along the MAC

    • calculatePoly

      private void calculatePoly()
      Calculate CP position interpolation polynomial coefficients from the fin geometry. This is a fifth order polynomial that satisfies p(0.5)=0.25 p'(0.5)=0 p(2) = f(2) p'(2) = f'(2) p''(2) = 0 p'''(2) = 0 where f(M) = (ar*sqrt(M^2-1) - 0.67) / (2*ar*sqrt(M^2-1) - 1). The values were calculated analytically in Mathematica. The coefficients are used as poly[0] + poly[1]*x + poly[2]*x^2 + ...
